description_en: Refreshes node group configurations to existing nodes. Manually triggers the node group configuration to take effect on existing nodes. After node group properties are changed, existing nodes do not perform automatic synchronization by default, which causes configuration drift. You can call this operation to refresh node properties. The operation returns an asynchronous refresh task ID, and the result can be queried through DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask
description_zh: 刷新节点组的配置到存量节点：手动触发节点组配置向存量节点生效。节点组属性变更后，存量节点默认不自动同步，存在配置漂移，用户可调用本接口刷新节点属性。接口返回异步刷新任务ID，结果可通过 DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask 查询
name: RefreshNodeGroupNodes

parameters.help_en:
The maximum disruptive action level allowed for the refresh operation. The system independently evaluates the action level required to refresh each drifted property of a node and performs the refresh within the specified action level constraint. If the action level required for a property exceeds the specified level, that property is skipped. Action levels in increasing order of disruption: Refresh < Reboot < Reimage.
Refresh (default): only refreshes the configuration in place without restarting or reimaging. Currently applicable only to the RamRoleName property.
Reboot (not currently supported): allows restarting the node for the configuration to take effect. Supported properties include system cloud disk type and all properties supported by Refresh.
Reimage (not currently supported): allows reimaging the node for the configuration to take effect. Supported properties include image ID and all properties supported by Reboot
parameters.help_zh:
刷新操作允许的最大破坏性动作等级。系统对节点每个漂移属性独立评估刷新所需的动作等级，在满足指定动作等级约束的前提下执行刷新操作；若某属性所需动作等级超过指定等级，则跳过该属性。动作等级按破坏性递增：Refresh < Reboot < Reimage。
Refresh（默认）：仅原地刷新配置，不执行重启或重装。当前仅适用于 RamRoleName 属性。
Reboot（当前不支持）：允许通过重启节点以使配置生效。支持的属性包括系统盘类型、以及 Refresh 支持的所有属性。
Reimage（当前不支持）：允许通过重装节点以使配置生效。支持的属性包括镜像 ID、以及 Reboot 支持的所有属性
parameters.name: max_disruptive_action

parameters.help_en: The filter scope for node refresh. If not specified, all nodes in the node group are included. <warning>If the instance type is a hypernode, pass in the TrayNode ID, not the HyperNodeId.</warning>
parameters.help_zh: 指定节点刷新的筛选边界，未指定时代表节点组下所有节点。<warning>若机型为超节点，这里传入TrayNode的Id，不是HyperNodeId</warning>
parameters.name: node_ids

NodeGroupRefreshTaskId.description_en: The task ID. Query the task progress through DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask. If no node has configuration drift, no task is created and this field returns an empty string
NodeGroupRefreshTaskId.description_zh: 任务ID，任务进展可通过DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask来查询进展。无任何节点存在配置漂移时不创建任务，该字段返回空字符串
NodeGroupRefreshTaskId.title_zh: 任务ID，任务进展可通过DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask来查询进展。无任何节点存在配置漂移时不创建任务，该字段返回空字符串。
